passage: The school in Kalpur sat under a big neem tree, and children sat on jute mats. Farhan looked at Naveen, who was sitting next to him. His heart was thumping so loudly he thought she might hear it. He held up his bag of shiny pebbles. "Do you want to play?" he asked in a small voice. Naveen looked at the pebbles and nodded. "Yes!" Farhan grinned and stood up straight. They threw the pebbles into the circle drawn in the dust, taking turns, and Farhan forgot about his heart altogether.

qa.q: What did Farhan hold up when he asked Naveen to play?
qa.a: Farhan held up his bag of shiny pebbles.

qa.q: How did Farhan feel as he asked Naveen and after she said yes?
qa.a: He was nervous first, and then brave and happy. His thumping heart shows the nerves, and the grin and straight back show his joy.

qa.q: What did Farhan do well in making a friend, and what could he do if she had said no?
qa.a: He made the first move kindly, even though he was shy. If she had said no, he could try again another day or ask another child.

qa.q: What might Naveen have thought when Farhan spoke in a small voice?
qa.a: Naveen may have seen that he was a bit shy and felt glad to be asked. She said yes at once and looked at the pebbles with interest.

grounding: A young child likes a classmate and shyly asks her to play, feeling brave and happy when she says yes.
